t: Session XXII › Indiction of the next Session

items.e: Yet further, the same sacred and holy Synod of Trent, appoints the day of the next session for the Thursday after the octave of the feast of All Saints, which will be the twelfth day of the month of November; and it will therein decree touching the sacrament of Orders, and the sacrament of Matrimony, &c.
The session was prorogued until the fifteenth day of July, 1563.
